name: Awkward Rondo
original_name: アークワード・ロンド
source:
"Trick or treat!"
The sound of lively children's voices, the usual scene.
Just when it seemed like another year would pass without a hitch...

"You're so lucky, you get to participate in a game I made!"
I heard a voice laughing in the background.

Will I be able to escape from this man's game?
It was as if I could hear an awkward rondo being played on Halloween.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21392]Freem[/url]]
translation:
“不给糖就捣蛋！”
孩子们活泼的声音，一如往常的景象。
正当我以为这一年也会平安无事地过去时……

“你可真幸运，竟然能参加我制作的游戏！”
背景中传来了一个带着笑意的声音。

我能逃出这个男人设计的游戏吗？
万圣节之夜，仿佛有一首别扭的回旋曲，正在耳边奏响。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21392]Freem[/url]]
